title: The Attempted Assassination of Donald Trump

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接听了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空中的七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最强的队伍。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一锅出的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 现在订阅可享受特别优惠，网址是 nytimes.com/subscribe。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西。

sentences.en: And this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: The nation is waking up to a new reality.
sentences.zh: 全国人民正在醒来面对一个新的现实。

sentences.en: After former President Donald Trump was injured in an apparent assassination attempt.
sentences.zh: 在前总统唐纳德·特朗普遭遇明显的暗杀企图并受伤之后。

sentences.en: Gunshots ripping through a Pennsylvania campaign rally and carving their way into the history books.
sentences.zh: 枪声撕裂了宾夕法尼亚州的一场竞选集会，并在史册上刻下了印记。

sentences.en: I heard pop, pop.
sentences.zh: 我听到了砰、砰的声音。

sentences.en: I think a lot of people in the crowd just thought it was fireworks going off.
sentences.zh: 我想人群中的很多人只是以为那是放烟花。

sentences.en: I knew immediately it was gunshots.
sentences.zh: 我立刻就知道那是枪声。

sentences.en: And everybody's screaming drop and you can see the blood like splatter on his face and the Secret Service just barricades him.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在尖叫着趴下，你可以看到血溅在他的脸上，特勤局的人立刻把他围了起来。

sentences.en: And you know, it was just like so scary.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那真的太可怕了。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: Senior law enforcement officials say the gunman was a 20-year-old man from Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 高级执法官员称，枪手是一名来自宾夕法尼亚州的20岁男子。

sentences.en: A gunman was on the roof of a building several hundred feet from the lectern where Trump was speaking.
sentences.zh: 一名枪手当时正位于距离特朗普演讲讲台几百英尺远的一栋建筑的屋顶上。

sentences.en: What do we know about the attempted assassination of former President Donald Trump at a rally in Pennsylvania?
sentences.zh: 关于前总统唐纳德·特朗普在宾夕法尼亚州集会上遭遇的暗杀企图，我们了解些什么？

sentences.en: I just go back to this idea that something has been fundamentally changed.
sentences.zh: 我总是回到这个想法，即有些事情已经发生了根本性的改变。

sentences.en: People are desperate for answers to figure out how this could have happened, how to prevent it.
sentences.zh: 人们迫切需要答案，想弄清楚这怎么可能发生，以及如何预防它。

sentences.en: My colleague, photographer Doug Mills, recounts what it was like to witness the shooting.
sentences.zh: 我的同事，摄影师道格·米尔斯，讲述了目击枪击事件的经过。

sentences.en: And reporter Glenn Thrush on the state of the investigation into the man who did it.
sentences.zh: 还有记者格伦·思拉什关于对肇事者调查进展的报道。

sentences.en: It's Monday, July 15th.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月15日，星期一。

sentences.en: Oh, this is him.
sentences.zh: 哦，就是他。

sentences.en: I have to reroute through this thing, though.
sentences.zh: 不过我得通过这个东西重新连接一下。

sentences.en: Hold on.
sentences.zh: 等一下。

sentences.en: Doug?
sentences.zh: 道格？

sentences.en: Hey, Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 嘿，萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: Oh, still a little shaken up, actually.
sentences.zh: 哦，其实还有点惊魂未定。

sentences.en: I never thought I'd ever be in a situation like this or be part of a story like this.
sentences.zh: 我从没想过自己会陷入这样的境地，或者成为这样一个故事的一部分。

sentences.en: It's not something I ever dreamed of having happen in my career.
sentences.zh: 这不是我职业生涯中梦寐以求会发生的事情。

sentences.en: And it shakes you up.
sentences.zh: 这真的让人心有余悸。

sentences.en: I mean, it's pretty damn frightening.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这太可怕了。

sentences.en: Doug Mills has been photographing presidents for over 40 years.
sentences.zh: 道格·米尔斯拍摄总统已经超过40年了。

sentences.en: I spoke to him on Saturday night, about four hours after the shooting.
sentences.zh: 我在周六晚上，也就是枪击事件发生约四小时后与他进行了交谈。

sentences.en: What's in your head right now?
sentences.zh: 你现在脑子里在想什么？

sentences.en: My first thought is, obviously, I am thankful that the former president is not more seriously injured than he is.
sentences.zh: 我的第一个念头显然是，我很庆幸前总统受的伤没有更严重。

sentences.en: I'm saddened that other people lost their life.
sentences.zh: 我也为其他人失去了生命感到难过。

sentences.en: I mean, as much as I cover the president of the United States, whether it's former President Trump or President Biden or President Obama, all the way back to Reagan,
sentences.zh: 我是说，无论我报道的是哪位美国总统，无论是前总统特朗普、拜登总统还是奥巴马总统，一直追溯到里根时期，

sentences.en: it seems, you know, more and more intense and more and more divided and sadly scarier as the days grow on.
sentences.zh: 似乎，你知道，日子一天天过去，局势变得越来越紧张，越来越分裂，也越来越令人害怕。

sentences.en: And just having this happen in front of you and I'm sitting here in the car and I'm in a dark parking lot and I'm, you know, just hearing those gunshots.
sentences.zh: 就在你面前发生这种事，我坐在车里，在一个昏暗的停车场，你知道，我还在回响着那些枪声。

sentences.en: Where were you?
sentences.zh: 你在哪里？

sentences.en: How far from the former president were you?
sentences.zh: 你离前总统有多远？

sentences.en: When the shots came from him, I was probably less than three feet from him, maybe four at the most, because I was right up against the stage and he was directly above me.
sentences.zh: 当枪声响起时，我离他可能不到三英尺，最多四英尺，因为我就紧挨着舞台，而他就直接在我上方。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Doug, you yourself could have been hit.
sentences.zh: 道格，你自己也可能被击中。

sentences.en: Believe me, Serena, I when he was whisked off, I turned around and I saw people scattering and I thought, oh, my God, I was right in the line.
sentences.zh: 相信我，萨布丽娜，当他被迅速带走时，我转过身看到人们四散奔逃，我想，天哪，我刚才就在射击线上。

sentences.en: My heart was pounding through my chest and I was shaking and, you know, I was just like, I can't believe this happened.
sentences.zh: 我的心脏在胸腔里狂跳，我浑身发抖，你知道，我当时想，我简直不敢相信发生了这种事。

sentences.en: So tell me exactly what you saw through your camera lens, Doug.
sentences.zh: 那么，道格，请告诉我你通过相机镜头到底看到了什么。

sentences.en: What were you looking at right before and then what did you see exactly at the moment that it happened?
sentences.zh: 在事件发生前你看着什么，而在那一刻你到底看到了什么？

sentences.en: I was focused on the former president as he was making his remarks.
sentences.zh: 前总统发表讲话时，我的注意力都集中在他身上。

sentences.en: There was a huge flag, American flag above him flying.
sentences.zh: 他上方有一面巨大的美国国旗在飘扬。

sentences.en: I was trying to do something that showed him on the podium and him with the flag up there.
sentences.zh: 我当时正试图拍摄一张能展现他在讲台上，同时背景有国旗的照片。

sentences.en: And I was in the right moment as far as concentrating and being right there so I could see him.
sentences.zh: 我当时正处于专注的状态，就在那里，所以我能看到他。

sentences.en: And then the former president was making remarks.
sentences.zh: 然后前总统正在发表讲话。

sentences.en: He was gesturing towards his right.
sentences.zh: 他正向他的右侧做手势。

sentences.en: And when he put his hand out to gesture, something that said, take a look what happened.
sentences.zh: 当他伸出手做手势时，就像是在说，看看发生了什么。

sentences.en: There were these three or four loud pops.
sentences.zh: 传来了三四声巨大的爆裂声。

sentences.en: And I just kept taking pictures and it all became a blur.
sentences.zh: 我只是不停地拍照，一切都变得模糊了。

sentences.en: I just kept my finger on the shutter.
sentences.zh: 我的手指一直按在快门上。

sentences.en: And then he grabbed his ear and then fell from behind the podium.
sentences.zh: 然后他抓住了自己的耳朵，接着从讲台后面倒了下去。

sentences.en: I didn't see him behind the Trump sign.
sentences.zh: 我在特朗普的标牌后面没看到他。

sentences.en: And I ran to the left to try and see what was going on.
sentences.zh: 我向左跑去，想看看发生了什么。

sentences.en: And by that time, he was being covered by the Secret Service.
sentences.zh: 到那时，他已经被特勤局的人掩护起来了。

sentences.en: And there was a lot of yelling and pushing and, you know, just them trying to protect him and getting over top of him.
sentences.zh: 到处都是叫喊声和推搡声，你知道，他们只是试图保护他，并压在他身上。

sentences.en: And I'm positive I heard them say, sir, sir, sir, you know, and I think they were just trying to see how bad he was.
sentences.zh: 我肯定听到了他们说，先生，先生，先生，你知道，我想他们只是想看看他伤得有多重。

sentences.en: He was hit.
sentences.zh: 他被击中了。

sentences.en: And after that, it was very chaotic.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，现场非常混乱。

sentences.en: There was a lot of like, move back, get out of the way, move back.
sentences.zh: 到处都是那种喊声，往后退，让开，往后退。

sentences.en: Did you know where the gunman was?
sentences.zh: 你知道枪手在哪里吗？

sentences.en: No, I only knew that the pops came definitely from my left ear.
sentences.zh: 不知道，我只知道枪声绝对是从我的左耳方向传来的。

sentences.en: I could hear it very loud.
sentences.zh: 我听得很清楚。

sentences.en: So I assume that's where they came from.
sentences.zh: 所以我假设枪声就是从那里传来的。

sentences.en: And did that person continue to shoot?
sentences.zh: 那个人还在继续射击吗？

sentences.en: I thought I heard maybe two or three more shots.
sentences.zh: 我想我可能又听到了两三声枪响。

sentences.en: After the former president disappeared from your lens.
sentences.zh: 是在前总统从你的镜头中消失之后吗？

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I don't know if that was the Secret Service shooting back at that point.
sentences.zh: 我不知道那是不是特勤局当时在还击。

sentences.en: But I did hear more than, you know, the first three or four.
sentences.zh: 但我确实听到了超过最初那三四声的枪响。

sentences.en: I mean, they were very quick, which now that I look back, I was an idiot to be that close.
sentences.zh: 我是说，它们非常快，现在回想起来，我当时离得那么近真是个白痴。

sentences.en: But instincts just brought me closer, you know, to the stage to try and see what was going on.
sentences.zh: 但本能让我靠得更近，你知道，靠近舞台去看看发生了什么。

sentences.en: And then when they brought him up, I thought, oh, my God, he's OK.
sentences.zh: 然后当他们把他扶起来时，我想，天哪，他没事。

sentences.en: He's alive.
sentences.zh: 他还活着。

sentences.en: And then he put his fist up.
sentences.zh: 然后他举起了拳头。

sentences.en: And then as he got closer to the steps, he kind of stopped with the agents.
sentences.zh: 当他靠近台阶时，他和特工们停了一下。

sentences.en: And I could tell the agents were trying to put their arms over him to shield him.
sentences.zh: 我能看出特工们正试图用手臂护住他，为他挡住危险。

sentences.en: And he was defiant.
sentences.zh: 而他表现得很挑衅。

sentences.en: What did you think when you saw Trump do that?
sentences.zh: 当你看到特朗普那样做时，你在想什么？

sentences.en: You captured that moment.
sentences.zh: 你捕捉到了那一刻。

sentences.en: What did you think when he did that?
sentences.zh: 他那样做时你在想什么？

sentences.en: Oh, he was just so just pissed off, like defiant.
sentences.zh: 哦，他当时只是非常愤怒，表现得很挑衅。

sentences.en: That's all that I could think of was, God, he's mad as hell.
sentences.zh: 我当时脑子里想的只有，天哪，他气疯了。

sentences.en: He is really mad.
sentences.zh: 他真的非常生气。

sentences.en: You know, the image that you took of former President Trump pumping his fist in the air with the blood on his face, with the Secret Service all huddled around him,
sentences.zh: 你知道，你拍的那张前总统特朗普挥舞拳头、脸上带着血迹、特勤局人员围在他身边的照片，

sentences.en: the one you referenced, this photo is in many ways already becoming really the iconic photo of this moment, defining the episode in history, really.
sentences.zh: 你提到的这张照片在很多方面已经成为了这一时刻的标志性照片，真正定义了历史上的这一事件。

sentences.en: Did you know immediately that would be the case?
sentences.zh: 你当时立刻就知道会是这样吗？

sentences.en: I didn't, Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: I didn't.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I didn't know what I, you know, because it was happening so faSt.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，因为一切发生得太快了。

sentences.en: And at that point, my camera went from in my eye to lifting it up above me.
sentences.zh: 在那一刻，我的相机从眼睛前移开，举到了头顶上方。

sentences.en: And just because there were people in front of me that, you know,
sentences.zh: 只是因为前面有人，你知道，

sentences.en: I just I had no idea that it would be the image it is until I saw it on the camera afterwards when I was shaking and looking at my pictures thinking, oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 我根本没想到它会成为现在这样的一张照片，直到我事后在相机上看到它，当时我浑身发抖，看着我的照片，心想，天哪。

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: You know, it brings chills to me.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这让我不寒而栗。

sentences.en: It is definitely an image that I'll think about when I close my eyes tonight to go to sleep at some wee hour in the morning.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是我今晚闭眼睡觉时会想起的一张照片，无论是在凌晨几点。

sentences.en: Doug, there's one photograph you took with a kind of blurred, moving image, and it looks like it might actually be a bullet, a bullet streaking past the former president.
sentences.zh: 道格，你拍了一张照片，画面有点模糊，看起来可能真的是一颗子弹，一颗从前总统身边擦过的子弹。

sentences.en: Can you talk about that photo?
sentences.zh: 你能谈谈那张照片吗？

sentences.en: Is that actually one of the bullets?
sentences.zh: 那真的是其中一颗子弹吗？

sentences.en: I never thought that I would have a picture of the bullet behind him.
sentences.zh: 我从没想过我能拍到他身后子弹的照片。

sentences.en: But after the event had happened and I'm looking through my camera at pictures that I'm going to send to the office, and I said to the editor, Jennifer, listen, Jen,
sentences.zh: 但在事件发生后，我翻看相机里要发给办公室的照片，我对编辑詹妮弗说，听着，珍，

sentences.en: I'm sending you the sequence of when he was speaking when the shots rang out.
sentences.zh: 我正在给你发送他讲话时枪声响起的那一连串照片。

sentences.en: And please look at him closely, because at that point there were speculation that he was not shot.
sentences.zh: 请仔细看看他，因为当时有人猜测他并没有中枪。

sentences.en: And, you know, I called Maggie, one of our reporters, and Maggie Haberman said, hey, Maggie, I definitely think he was shot because he looks to his right, he flinches,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我给我们的记者之一玛吉打了电话，玛吉·哈伯曼说，嘿，玛吉，我绝对认为他中枪了，因为他看向右边，他畏缩了，

sentences.en: he grabs his ear, his hand has blood on it at that point.
sentences.zh: 他抓住了耳朵，那时他的手上已经有血了。

sentences.en: And then he went down.
sentences.zh: 然后他倒了下去。

sentences.en: So when I asked Jen, can you look at him closely?
sentences.zh: 所以当我问珍，你能仔细看看他吗？

sentences.en: And Jen said, I will.
sentences.zh: 珍说，我会的。

sentences.en: And she literally texted me back a minute later and said, you won't believe this.
sentences.zh: 她一分钟后就给我回了短信说，你绝对不会相信这个。

sentences.en: We think there's a picture of the bullet flying behind the former president's head.
sentences.zh: 我们认为有一张照片拍到了子弹从前总统头后飞过的画面。

sentences.en: And I said, what?
sentences.zh: 我说，什么？

sentences.en: And I'm getting chills now because I now that I've seen the picture and I am looking at the sequence because there's nothing there, nothing there, nothing there.
sentences.zh: 我现在又感到不寒而栗了，因为我已经看到了那张照片，我正在查看那一连串画面，因为之前什么都没有，什么都没有，什么都没有。

sentences.en: And then it's right behind his head.
sentences.zh: 然后它就在他头后方。

sentences.en: And, well, of course, we haven't at this hour, 9.54 p.m., exactly confirmed that this is the image of the bullet that hurt him.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当然，在现在这个时间，晚上9点54分，我们还没有确切证实这就是伤害他的那颗子弹的影像。

sentences.en: But it certainly seems like it could be that you captured the exact moment that he got shot.
sentences.zh: 但这看起来确实像是你捕捉到了他中枪的确切瞬间。

sentences.en: It was, I mean, from what I can tell, it's definitely a bullet that was fired at him, whether it hit him or not, his TBD.
sentences.zh: 我是说，据我所知，这绝对是一颗向他射出的子弹，至于它是否击中了他，还有待确认。

sentences.en: I just don't know at this time, like you said.
sentences.zh: 就像你说的，我现在还不确定。

sentences.en: Doug, you said that when this shooting happened, that your instinct was to keep your finger on the shutter.
sentences.zh: 道格，你说过枪击发生时，你的本能是让手指按在快门上。

sentences.en: And, you know, that's a pretty unique instinct.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那是一种非常独特的本能。

sentences.en: It's a photographer instinct, and I love that.
sentences.zh: 这是摄影师的本能，我喜欢这一点。

sentences.en: But I'm assuming that's all kind of your accumulated experience over the decades.
sentences.zh: 但我假设这都是你几十年来积累的经验。

sentences.en: You know, you referenced this earlier, but you've covered presidents for four decades.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你之前提到过，但你已经报道总统四十年了。

sentences.en: You've captured the most historic moments, probably present for more of the history in our country than any other journalist in Washington.
sentences.zh: 你捕捉到了最具历史意义的时刻，你可能是在场见证我国历史比华盛顿任何其他记者都多的人。

sentences.en: How are you thinking about this event in the context of all of the others that you've been present for?
sentences.zh: 在所有你曾亲历的事件背景下，你是如何看待这次事件的？

sentences.en: Yeah, this is by far the most remarkable and sad situation that I've ever witnessed.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是我见过的最引人注目、最悲伤的情况，没有之一。

sentences.en: You know, seeing a person running for president of the United States, someone's trying to end their life.
sentences.zh: 你知道，看到一个竞选美国总统的人，有人试图结束他们的生命。

sentences.en: And, you know, as a photographer, you hope that if you're there for that day, that you're able to do your job, and then you're in the right place to do your job.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，作为一名摄影师，你希望如果你在那一天在场，你能够做好你的工作，并且你处于正确的位置来完成你的工作。

sentences.en: And that's all I kept thinking, you know, was I was trying to run around the stage, trying to, you know, just to see, you know, how the former president was doing.
sentences.zh: 我当时脑子里想的只有这些，你知道，我当时正试图绕着舞台跑，试图，你知道，只是想看看，你知道，前总统的情况如何。

sentences.en: And I hope I didn't blink.
sentences.zh: 我希望我当时没有眨眼。

sentences.en: I hopefully captured what happened, and that's what my job is, to record history.
sentences.zh: 我希望能捕捉到当时发生的一切，这就是我的工作，记录历史。

sentences.en: And this is definitely one of those historic moments that sadly I was a part of, but also I'm grateful that I didn't flinch and I didn't blink and I wasn't shot.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是那些历史性时刻之一，遗憾的是我身处其中，但我也很庆幸自己没有退缩，没有眨眼，也没有中弹。

sentences.en: So I'm grateful for that.
sentences.zh: 所以我对此心怀感激。

sentences.en: Yes, you were our witness, Doug.
sentences.zh: 是的，你是我们的见证人，道格。

sentences.en: Well, thank you, Suprema.
sentences.zh: 嗯，谢谢你，苏普雷玛。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Lowe.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·洛。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games, and I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的《Connections》谜题，我非常喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog, and I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗，也喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基，我每天负责制作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由人制作的，就像你们刚才听到的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 即可开始游玩。

sentences.en: Glenn, you've been reporting on the investigation into the shooting at President Trump's rally on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 格伦，你一直在报道周六特朗普总统集会上的枪击事件调查。

sentences.en: We're talking to you at 4.55 p.m.
sentences.zh: 我们现在是下午4点55分与你通话。

sentences.en: on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 在周日。

sentences.en: Before we get to the details of what's been found so far, what do we know about how Trump is doing, how he's been in the hours since the shooting?
sentences.zh: 在了解目前发现的细节之前，我们知道特朗普现在情况如何？枪击发生后的这几个小时里他状态怎么样？

sentences.en: Remarkably well.
sentences.zh: 非常好。

sentences.en: While it was sort of shocking on television, you could see the blood splatter across his cheek.
sentences.zh: 虽然在电视上看起来有些令人震惊，你可以看到血迹溅在他的脸颊上。

sentences.en: It was an injury on his ear, but his injuries were relatively minimal.
sentences.zh: 那是耳朵上的伤，但他的伤势相对较轻。

sentences.en: He was cleared at a local hospital, flew back to his golf resort at Bedminster in New Jersey,
sentences.zh: 他在当地一家医院接受了检查，随后飞回了位于新泽西州贝德明斯特的高尔夫度假村，

sentences.en: and has made it entirely clear that he doesn't have any intention to skip the Republican National Convention in Milwaukee this week.
sentences.zh: 并且明确表示他完全没有打算错过本周在密尔沃基举行的共和党全国代表大会。

sentences.en: And do we know for sure it was a bullet that hit him?
sentences.zh: 我们能确定击中他的是子弹吗？

sentences.en: That's a little bit ambiguous.
sentences.zh: 这一点还有点模糊。

sentences.en: There were some reports that he was injured by flying glass from his teleprompter.
sentences.zh: 有报道称他是被提词器飞溅的玻璃碎片所伤。

sentences.en: But in a Truth Social post, he said he was shot by a bullet.
sentences.zh: 但在“真实社交”（Truth Social）的一篇帖子中，他说自己是被子弹击中的。

sentences.en: And in a conference call today with the FBI, they refused to address the issue at all.
sentences.zh: 而在今天与联邦调查局的电话会议中，他们拒绝就此问题发表任何评论。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And what about the people in the crowd who were also hit?
sentences.zh: 那么人群中同样中弹的人情况如何？

sentences.en: One man was killed.
sentences.zh: 有一名男子丧生。

sentences.en: His name is Corey Comperator, and he was apparently shielding his family from the gunfire.
sentences.zh: 他的名字是科里·康佩拉托，据称当时他正在保护家人免受枪击。

sentences.en: And in addition, two other bystanders were seriously injured, and they were taken to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 此外，还有两名旁观者受重伤，已被送往医院。

sentences.en: So, Glenn, what is the picture that law enforcement has pieced together about what happened on Saturday?
sentences.zh: 那么，格伦，执法部门拼凑出的周六事件经过是怎样的？

sentences.en: Well, the FBI and Department of Justice are investigating this as an assassination attempt and also a potential incident of domestic terrorism.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局和司法部正将此案作为暗杀未遂以及潜在的国内恐怖主义事件进行调查。

sentences.en: And here's the picture that they've compiled.
sentences.zh: 以下是他们汇总的情况。

sentences.en: It started off as a regular Trump rally.
sentences.zh: 起初这只是一场普通的特朗普集会。

sentences.en: Everything seemed to be in order.
sentences.zh: 一切似乎都很正常。

sentences.en: People were in a good mood.
sentences.zh: 人们心情很好。

sentences.en: Trump started speaking at around 6 p.m.
sentences.zh: 特朗普在下午6点左右开始演讲。

sentences.en: And roughly 10 minutes into his speech, Trump was talking about immigration.
sentences.zh: 演讲进行了大约10分钟后，特朗普正在谈论移民问题。

sentences.en: That's when a gunshot is heard.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，传来了枪声。

sentences.en: Trump stops mid-sentence.
sentences.zh: 特朗普话说到一半停了下来。

sentences.en: Then he flinches.
sentences.zh: 然后他退缩了一下。

sentences.en: Trump then clutched his ear.
sentences.zh: 接着特朗普捂住了耳朵。

sentences.en: And you could see the splatter of blood across his cheeks.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到血迹溅在他的脸颊上。

sentences.en: Then another two shots are quickly fired.
sentences.zh: 随后又迅速响起了两声枪响。

sentences.en: And he ducks behind the podium.
sentences.zh: 他蹲到了讲台后面。

sentences.en: And almost immediately, this whole clutch of Secret Service agents surrounds Trump.
sentences.zh: 几乎立刻，一群特勤局特工围住了特朗普。

sentences.en: And then you hear a burst of about five more shots.
sentences.zh: 接着你听到了大约五声连续的枪响。

sentences.en: The crowd was completely disoriented.
sentences.zh: 人群完全陷入了混乱。

sentences.en: Some people were sort of cheering.
sentences.zh: 有些人还在欢呼。

sentences.en: Other people started screaming.
sentences.zh: 另一些人开始尖叫。

sentences.en: And you could see behind Trump that folks were responding to those people who had been injured.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到特朗普身后的人们正在对那些受伤的人进行救助。

sentences.en: At some point, a Secret Service sniper shoots back and kills the shooter.
sentences.zh: 在某个时刻，一名特勤局狙击手开枪还击并击毙了枪手。

sentences.en: We know from looking at footage that at this point, he's lying dead on a rooftop about 400 to 500 feet away from Trump.
sentences.zh: 我们从录像中得知，此时他正躺在距离特朗普约400到500英尺远的一处屋顶上，已经死亡。

sentences.en: And some of the images show an AR-15 style semi-automatic rifle laying near his body.
sentences.zh: 一些图像显示，他的尸体旁放着一把AR-15式半自动步枪。

sentences.en: The Secret Service are still laying on top of Trump, shielding him.
sentences.zh: 特勤局特工仍然趴在特朗普身上保护他。

sentences.en: Then you hear a couple of seconds later, shooter down, shooter down.
sentences.zh: 几秒钟后，你听到有人喊“枪手已击毙，枪手已击毙”。

sentences.en: And it's at that point that they start to move the agents that surround him kind of in a shell, slowly move him offstage.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，他们开始移动，特工们围成一个保护圈，缓慢地将他带离舞台。

sentences.en: And the thing I found most extraordinary, having covered Trump on and off all these years, is how quickly, when he realized that he was physically okay,
sentences.zh: 这些年来我断断续续报道过特朗普，我发现最非同寻常的一点是，当他意识到自己身体无碍时，他反应之快，

sentences.en: that he pivoted to a complete understanding of what the image was, what the moment meant politically.
sentences.zh: 他立刻完全理解了当时的画面，以及这一刻在政治上的意义。

sentences.en: And there's just this extraordinary moment of defiance, where he balls his fists, and the crowd starts to chant USA, USA, USA.
sentences.zh: 那是一个极其非同寻常的抗争时刻，他挥舞着拳头，人群开始高呼“美国，美国，美国”。

sentences.en: I just can't emphasize how extraordinary that was.
sentences.zh: 我无法用言语形容那一幕有多么非同寻常。

sentences.en: And just like he had this instinct that this may have been a horrific event, but he was somehow seeing it as a political one.
sentences.zh: 他似乎有一种直觉，意识到这可能是一场可怕的事件，但他却以某种方式将其视为一个政治契机。

sentences.en: He was making use of it and really connecting with the people at the rally.
sentences.zh: 他在利用这一时刻，并真正与集会现场的人们产生了共鸣。

sentences.en: Somebody who worked with Trump for many years said this to me a long time ago.
sentences.zh: 一位与特朗普共事多年的人很久以前曾对我这样说过。

sentences.en: A lot of other politicians play the music.
sentences.zh: 很多其他政客只是在演奏音乐。

sentences.en: They can read the notes.
sentences.zh: 他们能读懂乐谱。

sentences.en: Trump can hear the music.
sentences.zh: 而特朗普能听懂音乐。

sentences.en: And that was one of those moments where he intuitively understood the moment, understood the image, understood the sound,
sentences.zh: 那正是他直觉性地理解了当下、理解了画面、理解了舆论的时刻，

sentences.en: and behaved in a way that maximized his position going forward.
sentences.zh: 他的表现最大化地提升了他未来的地位。

sentences.en: It was really, really something else.
sentences.zh: 这真的非常、非常与众不同。

sentences.en: Okay, so on the shooter, it wasn't that he somehow passed through a security check or evaded a security check.
sentences.zh: 好的，关于枪手，他并不是通过了安检或规避了安检。

sentences.en: He was just completely outside the zone that the Secret Service considered the zone of danger, right?
sentences.zh: 他只是完全处于特勤局认为的危险区域之外，对吧？

sentences.en: The shooter was completely outside the event, on a warehouse roof, outside of where Trump was speaking.
sentences.zh: 枪手完全在活动区域之外，位于一个仓库屋顶上，在特朗普演讲地点之外。

sentences.en: There's some reporting that he may have attempted to get in earlier, but part of the complication here was that he wasn't actually within the perimeter of the event itself.
sentences.zh: 有报道称他可能早些时候试图进入，但这里的复杂之处在于，他实际上并不在活动本身的警戒范围内。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And what is the Secret Service saying about why it was that that building, with an apparent clear shot of the podium, was outside the perimeter?
sentences.zh: 特勤局对于那栋明显能清晰看到讲台的建筑为何处于警戒范围之外有什么说法吗？

sentences.en: Well, the Secret Service is an independent security agency that's responsible for the protection of the president and other senior American officials.
sentences.zh: 特勤局是一个独立的安保机构，负责保护总统和其他美国高级官员。

sentences.en: Candidates get protection as well.
sentences.zh: 候选人也会得到保护。

sentences.en: But they don't operate in isolation.
sentences.zh: 但他们并非孤立行动。

sentences.en: When they come to a town, they often coordinate with local law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 当他们来到一个城镇时，通常会与当地执法部门协调。

sentences.en: Sometimes you'll see, for instance, state police sealing off highways when the motorcade comes through.
sentences.zh: 例如，有时你会看到车队经过时，州警察会封锁高速公路。

sentences.en: Well, oftentimes, Secret Service will have control over the event itself, while local law enforcement is tasked with controlling things outside of the perimeter.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，特勤局会控制活动本身，而当地执法部门则负责控制警戒范围外的情况。

sentences.en: That appears to have been what happened in Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州的情况似乎就是这样。

sentences.en: There were four counter-sniper teams on Saturday, two Secret Service and two local.
sentences.zh: 周六有四个反狙击小组，两个来自特勤局，两个来自当地。

sentences.en: And the building outside the perimeter would typically have been under the purview of local law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 而警戒范围外的建筑通常属于当地执法部门的管辖范围。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So basically, Secret Service was taking care of security inside the lines of that perimeter, and local law enforcement was taking care of the security outside those lines.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，特勤局负责警戒线内的安保，而当地执法部门负责线外的安保。

sentences.en: And that's where the shooter was shooting from, outside the lines.
sentences.zh: 而枪手正是从线外开枪的。

sentences.en: Do we know what happened with local law enforcement there?
sentences.zh: 我们知道当地执法部门那里发生了什么吗？

sentences.en: How this shooter getting to the top of a roof ended up kind of falling through the cracks for them?
sentences.zh: 这个枪手是如何爬上屋顶，以至于让他们出现了疏漏？

sentences.en: Nobody's quite sure, but the speed with which this happened seems to have been an important dynamic.
sentences.zh: 没人能确定，但事件发生的速度似乎是一个重要的因素。

sentences.en: It wasn't like this guy was camped out for hours.
sentences.zh: 这不像这人已经在那里蹲守了几个小时。

sentences.en: It appears that he scrambled up onto the roof of the warehouse, moving rather quickly, and planted himself and then fired.
sentences.zh: 看起来他是迅速爬上仓库屋顶，动作很快，然后就位并开火。

sentences.en: So there wasn't a lot of time for law enforcement to react, apparently.
sentences.zh: 所以显然执法部门没有太多时间反应。

sentences.en: And what do we know so far about the shooter?
sentences.zh: 关于枪手，我们目前了解多少？

sentences.en: What have investigators learned?
sentences.zh: 调查人员发现了什么？

sentences.en: His name is Thomas Matthew Crooks.
sentences.zh: 他的名字是托马斯·马修·克鲁克斯。

sentences.en: He is 20 years old.
sentences.zh: 他今年20岁。

sentences.en: He's from Bethel Park, Pennsylvania, which is about 40 miles from the scene of the shooting.
sentences.zh: 他来自宾夕法尼亚州的伯特利公园，距离枪击现场约40英里。

sentences.en: He was generally regarded in school as a quiet, intelligent guy, and he'd been working as a dietary aide at a local nursing home.
sentences.zh: 他在学校里通常被认为是一个安静、聪明的孩子，曾在当地一家疗养院担任饮食助理。

sentences.en: And investigators told us that he was interested in chess and that he had recently taken up computer coding.
sentences.zh: 调查人员告诉我们，他对国际象棋感兴趣，最近还开始学习计算机编程。

sentences.en: And what do the authorities say about his motive?
sentences.zh: 当局对他的动机有什么说法吗？

sentences.en: They don't know.
sentences.zh: 他们不知道。

sentences.en: That is the big question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的疑问。

sentences.en: The public record is very scant.
sentences.zh: 公开记录非常匮乏。

sentences.en: He is a registered Republican.
sentences.zh: 他是一名注册共和党人。

sentences.en: This would have been his first presidential election voting.
sentences.zh: 这本应是他第一次参加总统选举投票。

sentences.en: And it appears that he gave $15, according to some reports, to a group that generally identifies as liberal.
sentences.zh: 据一些报道称，他似乎曾向一个通常被认为是自由派的团体捐赠了15美元。

sentences.en: But mostly, I would say, investigators are exasperated by the lack of any kind of directionality in terms of what his motivation or political beliefs have been.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，调查人员最感到困惑的是，在动机或政治信仰方面完全找不到任何方向性。

sentences.en: He has, for instance, not written any kind of political manifesto.
sentences.zh: 例如，他没有写过任何形式的政治宣言。

sentences.en: And there aren't even a trail of social media posts to fall back on.
sentences.zh: 甚至连可以追溯的社交媒体帖子都没有。

sentences.en: They're really hoping that once they are able to breach his cell phone, that that will unlock a trove of information that will point them in the right direction.
sentences.zh: 他们非常希望一旦能够破解他的手机，就能获得大量信息，从而指引他们找到正确的方向。

sentences.en: But he really is an enigmatic character right now.
sentences.zh: 但他现在确实是一个谜一样的人物。

sentences.en: Do authorities think his attack was highly planned?
sentences.zh: 当局认为他的袭击是经过精心策划的吗？

sentences.en: And is there any indication that more attacks were planned?
sentences.zh: 是否有迹象表明还有更多的袭击计划？

sentences.en: Nobody really knows.
sentences.zh: 没人真正知道。

sentences.en: The gun that he used was purchased by his father.
sentences.zh: 他使用的枪支是他父亲购买的。

sentences.en: Authorities are not clear whether or not his father gave it to him, lent it to him, or if he took it from his father.
sentences.zh: 当局尚不清楚是他父亲给他的、借给他的，还是他从父亲那里拿走的。

sentences.en: But they don't believe his father bought it on his behalf.
sentences.zh: 但他们不认为他父亲是代他购买的。

sentences.en: What they did find were some explosive devices.
sentences.zh: 他们确实发现了一些爆炸装置。

sentences.en: There were apparently some canisters found in the car that he had been driving,
sentences.zh: 据称在他驾驶的汽车里发现了一些罐状物，

sentences.en: which served the purpose of delaying the investigation for hours and hours yesterday as the bomb squad removed and deactivated these devices.
sentences.zh: 这导致昨天的调查被延误了数小时，拆弹小组不得不移除并拆除了这些装置。

sentences.en: And a law enforcement official told me that there was also a suspicious device found at his residence.
sentences.zh: 一位执法官员告诉我，在他的住所也发现了一个可疑装置。

sentences.en: So he clearly had some knowledge of both firearms and explosives, but they aren't sure where he picked it up and what he intended to do.
sentences.zh: 所以他显然具备一些枪支和爆炸物的知识，但他们不确定他是从哪里学到的，以及他打算做什么。

sentences.en: So this, of course, as you know, is the first time in about 40 years that a current or former president has been wounded in an assassination attempt.
sentences.zh: 如你所知，这是大约40年来现任或前任总统首次在暗杀企图中受伤。

sentences.en: Ronald Reagan, of course, was shot in 1981.
sentences.zh: 罗纳德·里根当然是在1981年被枪击的。

sentences.en: What fundamentally went wrong here?
sentences.zh: 这里到底出了什么根本性的问题？

sentences.en: Is there any way to see this other than as a colossal failure by the Secret Service?
sentences.zh: 除了特勤局的重大失职，还有其他看法吗？

sentences.en: I think this is going to be regarded as one of the darkest days in the history of the Secret Service.
sentences.zh: 我认为这将被视为特勤局历史上最黑暗的日子之一。

sentences.en: Now, all of us who have covered the White House have traveled with agents, tremendously high level of professionalism.
sentences.zh: 所有报道白宫的人都曾与特工同行，他们有着极高的专业素养。

sentences.en: And the job is difficult bordering on impossible at times.
sentences.zh: 这项工作有时难到近乎不可能。

sentences.en: But allowing someone to have a clear firing line to a major presidential candidate in the middle of this kind of highly polarized environment is frankly inconceivable.
sentences.zh: 但在这种高度极化的环境中，允许某人拥有针对主要总统候选人的清晰射击路线，坦率地说，是不可思议的。

sentences.en: And I think the other law enforcement agencies, including the FBI and folks at the Department of Justice,
sentences.zh: 我认为其他执法机构，包括联邦调查局和司法部的人员，

sentences.en: were fairly unvarnished in private in their criticism of the way that the Secret Service planned this.
sentences.zh: 在私下里对特勤局的规划方式提出了相当直白的批评。

sentences.en: So there are a lot of unanswered questions and some lawmakers have called for there to be a significant investigation of this.
sentences.zh: 所以还有很多未解之谜，一些议员已经呼吁对此进行重大调查。

sentences.en: And the House Oversight Committee will call the head of the Secret Service to testify over the next couple of weeks.
sentences.zh: 众议院监督委员会将在未来几周内传唤特勤局局长作证。

sentences.en: What has Trump said since the shooting?
sentences.zh: 特朗普在枪击事件后说了些什么？

sentences.en: He's been relatively muted.
sentences.zh: 他表现得相对低调。

sentences.en: I think one of the really amazing moments and something which has been kind of overlooked, Joe Biden called up Donald Trump and they seem to have had a civil exchange.
sentences.zh: 我认为一个非常令人惊叹的时刻，也是某种程度上被忽视的事情是，乔·拜登给唐纳德·特朗普打了电话，他们似乎进行了一次文明的交流。

sentences.en: I think it was this very, very rare and brief moment of comity in this campaign, which is just suffused with negativity and hostility.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是这场充满负面情绪和敌意的竞选中，非常、非常罕见且短暂的和谐时刻。

sentences.en: And then Trump called for national unity.
sentences.zh: 随后特朗普呼吁国家团结。

sentences.en: And he's basically kind of kept up that vibe for the past 24 hours.
sentences.zh: 在过去的24小时里，他基本上保持了这种基调。

sentences.en: But in his signature defiant way, he wrote in a text message to supporters, I will never surrender.
sentences.zh: 但他以标志性的抗争姿态在给支持者的短信中写道：“我绝不投降”。

sentences.en: And on True Social, he called for his supporters to stand united and not to allow, quote, evil to win.
sentences.zh: 在“真实社交”上，他呼吁支持者团结一致，不要让所谓的“邪恶”获胜。

sentences.en: But he really seems to be towing the line between his typical bombast and adopting a tone which is a little more conciliatory at a moment when Americans of all political stripes are extremely uneasy and many are just frankly terrified.
sentences.zh: 但他似乎确实在他典型的夸夸其谈和采取更温和的语气之间保持平衡，而此时此刻，各派政治立场的美国人都感到极度不安，许多人坦率地说感到恐惧。

sentences.en: And what have been the other reactions to this assassination attempt?
sentences.zh: 对于这次暗杀未遂，还有哪些其他反应？

sentences.en: What's been happening in Washington?
sentences.zh: 华盛顿那边情况如何？

sentences.en: What have the people been saying?
sentences.zh: 人们都在说些什么？

sentences.en: Democrats and administration officials have called for unity, essentially saying that this was not just an attack on Trump, but an attack on democracy.
sentences.zh: 民主党人和政府官员呼吁团结，本质上是说这不仅是对特朗普的攻击，更是对民主的攻击。

sentences.en: Look, there's no place in America for this kind of violence.
sentences.zh: 听着，在美国，这种暴力行为没有立足之地。

sentences.en: It's sick.
sentences.zh: 这太病态了。

sentences.en: It's sick.
sentences.zh: 这太病态了。

sentences.en: President Biden made it very clear in a couple of appearances over the weekend that he condemned the violence.
sentences.zh: 拜登总统在周末的几次露面中非常明确地谴责了这种暴力行为。

sentences.en: We cannot allow for this to be happening.
sentences.zh: 我们绝不能允许这种事情发生。

sentences.en: We cannot be like this.
sentences.zh: 我们不能变成这样。

sentences.en: We cannot condone this.
sentences.zh: 我们不能纵容这种行为。

sentences.en: And said that this kind of reaction, regardless of your political stance, was completely unacceptable.
sentences.zh: 并表示无论政治立场如何，这种反应都是完全不可接受的。

sentences.en: Republicans had a wider range of reactions.
sentences.zh: 共和党人的反应则各不相同。

sentences.en: There were some in the party who took a measured approach.
sentences.zh: 党内有些人采取了审慎的态度。

sentences.en: Everyone needs to turn the rhetoric down.
sentences.zh: 每个人都需要降低言辞的激烈程度。

sentences.en: Like from Speaker of the House, Mike Johnson.
sentences.zh: 比如众议院议长迈克·约翰逊。

sentences.en: You have political opposition and political opponents, but we're all Americans and we have to treat one another with dignity and respect.
sentences.zh: 你们有政治异见和政治对手，但我们都是美国人，我们必须以尊严和尊重对待彼此。

sentences.en: But you also heard some Republicans taking a far different approach.
sentences.zh: 但你也听到了一些共和党人采取了截然不同的做法。

sentences.en: You had people like Mike Collins, a kind of a firebrand Republican from Georgia, writing on social media that Joe Biden sent the orders to shoot Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 像来自佐治亚州的共和党激进派迈克·柯林斯这样的人，在社交媒体上写道，是乔·拜登下令枪击唐纳德·特朗普的。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Obviously, there's no evidence for that.
sentences.zh: 显然，没有任何证据支持这一点。

sentences.en: I do believe that Joe Biden is responsible for the shooting today.
sentences.zh: 我确实相信乔·拜登对今天的枪击事件负有责任。

sentences.en: And you had Lauren Boebert from Colorado in a television interview saying Joe Biden is responsible for the shooting.
sentences.zh: 还有来自科罗拉多州的劳伦·博伯特在电视采访中说，乔·拜登要为这次枪击负责。

sentences.en: Everyone who has called him a fascist, everyone who has called him a threat to democracy, who said that he should be.
sentences.zh: 每一个称他为法西斯的人，每一个称他为民主威胁的人，每一个说他应该……的人。

sentences.en: Essentially saying that it was Democratic rhetoric that caused this.
sentences.zh: 本质上是在说，是民主党的言论导致了这一切。

sentences.en: Again, there's been no evidence whatsoever yet that the shooter was motivated by that kind of rhetoric.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，目前没有任何证据表明枪手是受那种言论的驱使。

sentences.en: But that was a common Republican talking point that you saw emerging to say that using all of this description of Trump as an existential threat to democracy had somehow whipped up people to enact violent acts.
sentences.zh: 但这已成为共和党人普遍的谈资，他们认为将特朗普描述为对民主的生存威胁，在某种程度上煽动了人们采取暴力行为。

sentences.en: Okay, so there are some cross currents of rhetoric here in the aftermath of the shooting, and we see some signs of unity.
sentences.zh: 好吧，枪击事件发生后，这里确实存在一些相互矛盾的言论，我们也看到了一些团结的迹象。

sentences.en: But it seems undeniable that this is a very fraught political moment.
sentences.zh: 但不可否认的是，这是一个非常紧张的政治时刻。

sentences.en: How much have you been hearing in your reporting about the possibility of further violence?
sentences.zh: 在你的报道中，你听到了多少关于未来可能发生更多暴力的消息？

sentences.en: It's a huge fear, and it's building upon concerns that FBI and Justice Department officials have talked to us about for months and months and months,
sentences.zh: 这是一种巨大的恐惧，它建立在联邦调查局和司法部官员几个月来一直与我们讨论的担忧之上，

sentences.en: that they are worried about violence springing up in this election.
sentences.zh: 他们担心这次选举中会爆发暴力事件。

sentences.en: On a call on Sunday, they reiterated that the threat level is really high.
sentences.zh: 在周日的一次通话中，他们重申威胁级别非常高。

sentences.en: For months, they've been telling us that they're worried about shootings spawning copycats.
sentences.zh: 几个月来，他们一直告诉我们，他们担心枪击事件会引发模仿犯罪。

sentences.en: And also, outside of violence, it's this wave of misinformation that tends to accompany these big events that can also create a bad cycle.
sentences.zh: 此外，除了暴力之外，伴随这些重大事件而来的虚假信息浪潮也可能造成恶性循环。

sentences.en: People get whipped up, and that in turn incites more violence.
sentences.zh: 人们被煽动起来，这反过来又会引发更多的暴力。

sentences.en: So I think there is a level of tremendous uncertainty, and political conventions, as we have seen in years past, are a gathering point for all kinds of folks.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为存在着巨大的不确定性，正如我们过去几年所见，政治大会是各类人群的聚集点。

sentences.en: Mostly people who are engaged in peaceful protests, but it's also been catalytic for individuals who want to create all kinds of probleMs.
sentences.zh: 虽然大多数人是参与和平抗议的，但它也成为了那些想要制造各种麻烦的人的催化剂。

sentences.en: I think if there is a silver lining, it is that this near-miss, this near-national catastrophe, has alerted law enforcement agencies, particularly the Secret Service,
sentences.zh: 我认为如果说有什么一线希望的话，那就是这次险些发生的国家灾难，已经警示了执法机构，特别是特勤局，

sentences.en: to up their vigilance to the highest possible level.
sentences.zh: 将他们的警惕性提高到了最高水平。

sentences.en: So to a certain extent, like a near-miss of an airliner potentially crashing,
sentences.zh: 所以在某种程度上，就像客机差点坠毁一样，

sentences.en: it might have the positive impact of having people pay more attention at a time of what appears to be maximum danger.
sentences.zh: 它可能会产生积极的影响，让人们在看似处于最大危险的时刻更加警惕。

sentences.en: Glenn, what happens now?
sentences.zh: 格伦，现在会发生什么？

sentences.en: I mean, you mentioned political conventions.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你提到了政治大会。

sentences.en: The Republican National Convention is starting on Monday.
sentences.zh: 共和党全国代表大会周一开始。

sentences.en: Do we have any idea of how that event will play out, given what just happened?
sentences.zh: 鉴于刚刚发生的事情，我们知道这次活动会如何进行吗？

sentences.en: How this changes things?
sentences.zh: 这会如何改变局面？

sentences.en: Well, first and foremost, I think you're going to see a level of security at both conventions that's unprecedented.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先，我认为你会看到两场大会的安保级别都是前所未有的。

sentences.en: In terms of the political impact, that's a little harder to predict.
sentences.zh: 至于政治影响，这有点难预测。

sentences.en: This presents Donald Trump with an enormous opportunity to reset his image.
sentences.zh: 这对唐纳德·特朗普来说是一个重塑形象的巨大机会。

sentences.en: But it's an entirely unpredictable political environment, and the situation could change.
sentences.zh: 但这是一个完全不可预测的政治环境，局势可能会发生变化。

sentences.en: I think its greatest meaning, its most resonant meaning, is that our politics is changing and moving into a darker and more dangerous place.
sentences.zh: 我认为它最大的意义，最深刻的意义在于，我们的政治正在发生变化，正走向一个更黑暗、更危险的地方。

sentences.en: And the question is, are we entering an age where political violence becomes commonplace,
sentences.zh: 问题是，我们是否正在进入一个政治暴力变得司空见惯的时代，

sentences.en: or is this a moment where we realize collectively that this is not the future we can accept?
sentences.zh: 还是说这是一个我们集体意识到这不是我们所能接受的未来的时刻？

sentences.en: And what happens in the next few days is going to be quite important to help give an answer to that.
sentences.zh: 未来几天发生的事情对于回答这个问题将非常重要。

sentences.en: Indeed.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: Glenn, thank you.
sentences.zh: 格伦，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还应该了解的消息。

sentences.en: On Saturday, Israel conducted a major airstrike in the southern Gaza Strip that it said targeted Hamas's top military commander,
sentences.zh: 周六，以色列在加沙地带南部发动了一次大规模空袭，称其目标是哈马斯的高级军事指挥官，

sentences.en: who was allegedly one of the architects of the October 7th attack on Israel.
sentences.zh: 据称他是10月7日袭击以色列的策划者之一。

sentences.en: Gazan health authorities said that at least 90 people died in the assault.
sentences.zh: 加沙卫生部门表示，至少有90人在袭击中丧生。

sentences.en: But by Sunday night, it was not clear whether the commander targeted in the strike, Mohamed Daif, was among them.
sentences.zh: 但截至周日晚间，尚不清楚在空袭中被针对的指挥官穆罕默德·戴夫是否在其中。

sentences.zh: 今天的节目由Rob Zipko、Shannon Lynn、Lindsay Garrison和Stella Tan制作，Carlos Prieto提供了协助。

sentences.zh: 由Patricia Willans编辑，Paige Cowett提供了协助。

sentences.zh: 由Susan Lee进行事实核查。

sentences.zh: 包含Marian Lozano、Diane Wong、Sophia Landman和Pat McCusker的原创音乐。

sentences.zh: 由Alyssa Moxley进行工程处理。

sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的内容。

sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西。

sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》节目中，和我一起，莎拉·凯尼格，讲述那些试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的人们的故事。

sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.zh: 在任何你获取播客的地方收听。

sentences.zh: 我们走吧。

sentences.zh: 我们走吧。

sentences.zh: 我们走吧。
